data_description.currency: The currency the Bitcoin exchange rate is shown in.

deprecated_yaml_import_issue_cannot_conn.description:
Configuring {integration_title} using YAML is being removed.

While importing your YAML configuration, Home Assistant could not reach blockchain.com. Check your internet connection and restart Home Assistant to try again, or remove the `{domain}` sensor platform from your `configuration.yaml` file and set the integration up from the UI.
deprecated_yaml_import_issue_cannot_conn.title: The {integration_title} YAML configuration import failed

deprecated_yaml_import_issue_dropped_cur.description:
Configuring {integration_title} using YAML is being removed.

{integration_title} can only be set up once, so the sensor platform asking for `{currency}` was not imported and its exchange rate sensor is gone. To get the rate in `{currency}` back, remove the `{domain}` sensor platform from your `configuration.yaml` file, then delete the {integration_title} integration and add it again, picking `{currency}`.
deprecated_yaml_import_issue_dropped_cur.title: [%key:component::bitcoin::issues::deprecated_yaml_import_issue_cannot_connect::title%]

deprecated_yaml_import_issue_unknown_cur.description:
Configuring {integration_title} using YAML is being removed.

While importing your YAML configuration, Home Assistant found that blockchain.com does not quote Bitcoin in `{currency}`. Correct the currency in your `configuration.yaml` file and restart Home Assistant to try again, or remove the `{domain}` sensor platform and set the integration up from the UI.
deprecated_yaml_import_issue_unknown_cur.title: [%key:component::bitcoin::issues::deprecated_yaml_import_issue_cannot_connect::title%]

reused_entity_id.description:
Configuring {integration_title} using YAML is being removed.

Your YAML configuration listed `{option}` but not `{takes_over}`, so before this update `{entity_id}` was your `{option}` sensor. Every sensor is created now, so `{entity_id}` is the `{takes_over}` one and `{option}` is `{moved_to}`. If you used `{entity_id}` in dashboards, automations, or scripts, point them at `{moved_to}`.
reused_entity_id.title: A {integration_title} entity ID now belongs to another sensor
